Adam shares some advice for new makers setting up their early workshops: pay attention to power outlet management! As you accumulate tools and set up new equipment over time, the complexity of power distribution creeps up unexpectedly fast. Here are some essential tools for diagnosing issues that may pop up in your electrical setup, including some Adam recently used for troubleshooting the cave. 

Adam shares how he recently diagnosed an electrical outlet issue in his workshop
